claims.text: Victoria House is a beach resort on the east side of Ambergris Caye, facing Coconut Drive, the road into nearby San Pedro.

findings.quote: Victoria House is a beautiful beach resort on the east side of Ambergris Caye. We face Coconut Drive which is the road that takes you into nearby San Pedro.

claims.text: A tropical buffer separates the road from the resort's rooms, villas and casitas, which all face the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: a tropical buffer lays between the roadway and our blend of luxury staterooms, villas, Palmetto Rooms and casitas, which all face the magnificent Caribbean Sea

claims.text: Victoria House describes itself as a boutique resort for travelers seeking seclusion and intimacy.

findings.quote: Victoria House Resort and Spa is a boutique resort, offering exclusive Belize accommodations for those wondering where to stay in Belize and looking for seclusion and intimacy.

claims.text: The resort has an onsite dive shop and a tour desk.

findings.quote: tour desk, onsite dive shop

claims.text: Excursions include ancient Mayan temples, a zip-line tour over the jungle canopy, rainforest expeditions, fishing trips and diving the Great Blue Hole.

findings.quote: Explore ancient Mayan temples, take an exhilarating zip-line tour over the verdant jungle canopy, embark on a rainforest expedition, take a fishing trip or dive the renowned Great Blue Hole.

claims.text: Guests can use the resort's bicycles, kayaks and paddleboards.

findings.quote: Stay on site and enjoy our refreshing pools, bicycles, kayaks and paddleboards

claims.text: The casitas have a thatched roof, a queen bed, a private veranda and a hammock.

findings.quote: Discover the quintessential tropical casita, complete with a thatched roof, queen bed, private veranda, and your own hammock to relax in.

claims.text: The one-bedroom Infinity Suites have a gourmet kitchen and three private verandas, including a secluded upper terrace with ocean views.

findings.quote: Featuring a gourmet kitchen and three private verandas, including a secluded upper terrace with incredible ocean views.

claims.text: The Luxury Villas have traditional thatch roofs, mahogany four-poster canopied king beds and travertine bathrooms.

findings.quote: Each villa offers traditional thatch roofs, mahogany poster king size canopied beds, luxurious travertine bathrooms and more.

claims.text: At La Luna Spa, the Victoria House Signature Treatment combines a Coco Body Polish, a warm al fresco shower and a Signature Relaxation Massage.

findings.quote: La Luna Spa - Victoria House
Start with a Coco Body Polish, followed by a warm al-fresco shower, and finish with our Signature Relaxation Massage.

claims.text: Palmilla Restaurant is a full-service waterfront restaurant where fresh, local seafood is a specialty.

findings.quote: Palmilla Restaurant is an elegant, full-service restaurant located on the stunning waterfront
fresh, local seafood being a particular specialty

claims.text: Private candlelit dinners can be held on the pier palapa or at a private beach table lit with tiki torches.

findings.quote: a private, candlelit dinner on the beach overlooking the sea
dine in the seclusion of either our pier palapa or at your private beach table, lit with tiki torches under the tropical sky

claims.text: Victoria House sits at the edge of the Belize Barrier Reef.

findings.quote: perched right at the edge of one of the most stunning natural wonders of the world, the Belize Barrier Reef

claims.text: The beachfront villas Casa Playa Blanca and Casa Azul each have their own private pool.

findings.quote: Casa Playa Blanca and Casa Azul both have their own private pools.

claims.text: The Rainforest Suite is the resort's beachfront Honeymoon Suite, with a wraparound veranda, a private hammock and views of the Caribbean Sea.

findings.quote: This beachfront villa is our Honeymoon Suite and features a king bed, large tiled bathroom, a wraparound veranda with private hammock and stunning views of the Caribbean Sea.

claims.text: The resort has outdoor infinity-edged pools and a private beach.

findings.quote: outdoor infinity-edged pools and a spectacular private beach

claims.text: The spa offers the Arvigo Maya Abdominal Massage, developed in Belize with a traditional Maya healer.

findings.quote: Arvigo Maya Abdominal Massage
Developed in Belize with a traditional Maya healer

claims.text: Staff can help arrange golf cart rentals, taxis and shuttles for getting around.

findings.quote: They can also assist with golf cart rentals, taxis and shuttles.

claims.text: Room rates do not include government tax and service charge.

findings.quote: Rates are in $USD and do not include 9% government tax & 10% service charge.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the island location requires a boat or small aircraft transfer.
